chapters.title: Becoming Limitless
chapters.sourcePressure: The memoir-origin chapter: a childhood brain injury, shame around learning, and the first turn from a felt limit into trainable capability.
chapters.coreMove: Demote an old learning label from identity to a process that can be trained.
chapters.commonMisread: Treating the opener as inspirational origin-story uplift instead of a diagnostic split between wound, label, and method.

chapters.title: Why This Matters Now
chapters.sourcePressure: The frame widens to modern cognitive pressure: information overload, distraction, rapid change, and the premium on learning quickly and retaining well.
chapters.coreMove: Translate overwhelm into a reason to build a deliberate learning operating system.
chapters.commonMisread: Turning the chapter into broad technology panic or productivity scolding.

chapters.title: Your Limitless Brain
chapters.sourcePressure: The chapter shifts from urgency to capacity, arguing that present performance is not permanent potential and the brain should be treated as adaptable.
chapters.coreMove: Replace fixed-capacity assumptions with a trainability test while staying honest about limits.
chapters.commonMisread: Overclaiming neuroscience or promising a magical brain upgrade.

chapters.title: How to Read and Remember This (and Any) Book
chapters.sourcePressure: The reader is moved from passive consumption into active reading, retention posture, and deliberate engagement before later methods arrive.
chapters.coreMove: Read with retrieval in mind before the page disappears from working attention.
chapters.commonMisread: Dumping all speed-reading or memory tactics too early.

chapters.title: The Spell of Belief Systems
chapters.sourcePressure: The mindset section begins by showing how beliefs act as hidden ceilings on what effort, persistence, and learning methods feel reasonable.
chapters.coreMove: Catch a borrowed belief at the moment it shrinks effort before ability is tested.
chapters.commonMisread: Claiming belief alone removes every real constraint.

chapters.title: The 7 Lies of Learning
chapters.sourcePressure: The chapter clears common myths that keep learners passive, intimidated, dependent, or too quick to surrender.
chapters.coreMove: Audit a learning myth by the behavior it produces, then replace it with a testable rule.
chapters.commonMisread: Inventing an exact seven-item list unsupported by the frozen source.

chapters.title: Purpose
chapters.sourcePressure: The motivation section begins with purpose as the durable reason that makes effort survive beyond mood and shallow urgency.
chapters.coreMove: Tie the learning task to a reason strong enough to outlast the first wave of discomfort.
chapters.commonMisread: Treating purpose as inspirational slogan or implying everyone already knows theirs.

chapters.title: Energy
chapters.sourcePressure: Motivation is grounded in available energy, showing that cognitive performance and follow-through collapse when fuel is ignored.
chapters.coreMove: Diagnose a motivation failure as an energy constraint before blaming character.
chapters.commonMisread: Turning the chapter into medical advice or a prescriptive health protocol.

chapters.title: Small Simple Steps
chapters.sourcePressure: The motivation formula becomes behavioral by shrinking the first move so action can begin with less resistance.
chapters.coreMove: Lower the entry cost until the next visible action can happen now.
chapters.commonMisread: Confusing a small start with making the whole goal trivial.

chapters.title: Flow
chapters.sourcePressure: After action begins, the chapter explains deeper engagement through challenge, skill, and immersion without making flow mystical.
chapters.coreMove: Adjust challenge and conditions so attention can enter the task instead of bouncing off it.
chapters.commonMisread: Selling flow as effortless magic or forced peak state.

chapters.title: Focus
chapters.sourcePressure: The methods section opens by treating focus as the selective-attention gate that protects learning from switching and distraction.
chapters.coreMove: Close the competing pull before it dilutes the learning act.
chapters.commonMisread: Making focus a moral glare or a fantasy of perfect control.

chapters.title: Study
chapters.sourcePressure: Study follows focus by making the learner interact actively with material instead of trusting rereading or exposure alone.
chapters.coreMove: Turn exposure into a visible retrieval or explanation action.
chapters.commonMisread: Equating time-on-page with understanding or promising one trick for every subject.

chapters.title: Memory
chapters.sourcePressure: Memory becomes a method chapter, framing recall as supported by encoding, association, and retrieval rather than as a fixed gift.
chapters.coreMove: Build a retrieval path while the material is still warm instead of hoping recall appears later.
chapters.commonMisread: Turning memory into spectacle, photographic claims, or party tricks.

chapters.title: Speed Reading
chapters.sourcePressure: Reading efficiency is treated as cleaner pacing, reduced regressions, and preserved comprehension rather than careless skimming.
chapters.coreMove: Remove the friction that slows reading while matching speed to comprehension demands.
chapters.commonMisread: Equating speed reading with skimming or status performance.

chapters.title: Thinking
chapters.sourcePressure: The book closes by turning learning inputs into judgment, decisions, and connection-making rather than raw accumulation.
chapters.coreMove: Convert gathered information into a usable distinction before deciding.
chapters.commonMisread: Treating more information as the same thing as clearer judgment.
